page.layout: One column of index entries on the left, with page references in the same lines and some continuation lines indented beneath them. Text runs to the right edge of the scan. A letter heading appears at the top right.; One column of index entries, with page-number references on the left and headwords in the middle. The right side is cut off. Letter O heads the lower part.; One column of index entries, right-aligned page numbers, with the left-hand headwords cut off at the scan edge; a letter "O" heading in the middle.
page.notes: Top letter heading unreadable. Line "nobilis, les, nobilita" ends at the edge of the scan, so the rest of the word is not visible. Reference numbers at the right edge (215.534, 271) and the number after "nullus" are read from partial glyphs; the number after "nullus" is not transcribed. Attribution of the numbers 271 and 215.534 to their lines is uncertain. The right-hand part of each line, and the left edge, are cut off, so the references and the ends of the headwords may be incomplete. Several lines are read with [?] where the cut or the ink is unclear. The entries "566 | 473.508" and "870 | 846" are printed beside their headwords but their placement is uncertain. The large O initial is printed alone above "Obam". Left-hand headwords are cut off at the scan edge, so only their visible letters are given. Several lines have no visible headword; their page numbers are transcribed as printed.
